html: A recent study shows that farmers have a 40 percent lower risk of developing various common forms of cancer than people in the general population do. Farmers are more active than most people are, but even taking this into account, farmers had a significantly lower cancer risk. Therefore, it is likely that some substances that farmers are typically exposed to in the course of their work lower the risk of developing these forms of cancer.
zh:
①最近的一项研究表明，农民患各种常见形式癌症的风险比普通人群低40%。
②农民比大多数人更活跃，但即使考虑到这一点，农民患癌症的风险也显著更低。
③因此，农民在工作过程中通常接触到的一些物质可能会降低患这些形式癌症的风险。

qs.stem: Which of the following, if discovered to be true, would cast the most serious doubt on the argument?
qs.zh: 如果以下哪一项被发现是真的，会对这一论证产生最严重的质疑？

opts.t: There are types of cancers against which physical exercise has no known protective effect.
opts.cn: 体育锻炼对某些类型的癌症没有已知的保护作用。

opts.t: In the group that remains after urban dwellers are eliminated from the study’s sample, the risk of developing cancer is the same for farmers and nonfarmers.
opts.cn: 在研究样本中剔除城市居民后剩下的群体中，农民和非农人口患癌症的风险相同。

opts.t: There are types of cancers that occurred with equal frequency among the farmers and nonfarmers in the study’s sample.
opts.cn: 在研究样本中，有些类型的癌症在农民和非农民中的发生频率相同。

opts.t: Most of the substances that farmwork exposes a farmer to are typically present in the work environment of one or another nonfarming occupation.
opts.cn: 农民在务农过程中接触到的大多数物质通常存在于一种或另一种非农职业的工作环境中。

opts.t: Many farmers in the study’s sample were exposed to pesticides that have been shown to increase the risk of cancer.
opts.cn: 研究样本中的许多农民接触的农药已被证明会增加癌症的风险。

qs.label: B
qs.why:
背景：研究表明，农民患各种常见形式癌症的风险比普通人群低40%。
证据：即使考虑到农民比大多数人更活跃，农民患癌症的风险也显著更低。
结论：是农民在工作过程中通常接触到的一些物质降低了患这些形式癌症的风险。

A选项只是指出了体育锻炼作为一种保护因素的局限性，并没有直接质疑农民接触的物质可能会降低他们患癌症的风险的说法。
如果在排除城市居民后，农民和非农民的癌症风险相同，这表明在农民中观察到的较低风险可能是由于与城市生活相关的因素，而不是他们在农场接触到的物质，B选项可以削弱论证。
C选项不能反驳农业环境中存在可以降低其他形式癌症风险的物质的说法。
D选项没有排除这些物质在农业中的组合或浓度可能不同的可能性。
E选项并没有直接解决农业环境中存在降低癌症风险的物质的说法。

html: In an attempt to reduce the number of violent crimes committed by juveniles, the city of Fiera imposed a curfew requiring juveniles—everyone younger than eighteen—to be indoors between the hours of 11 P.M. and 6 A M. In the two years since the curfew was imposed, the number of violent crimes committed by juveniles in Fiera has fallen by almost ten percent. Clearly, therefore, the curfew has proven effective at reducing violent juvenile crime.
zh:
①为了减少青少年暴力犯罪的数量，F市实行了宵禁，要求青少年--所有18岁以下的青少年--在晚上11点到早上6点之间不得外出。
②在实施宵禁后的两年里，F市青少年暴力犯罪的数量几乎下降了 10%。
③因此，宵禁显然已被证明能有效减少青少年暴力犯罪。

qs.stem: Which of the following, if true, most weakens the argument?
qs.zh: 如果以下哪项为真，最能削弱这一论点？

opts.t: The majority of nonviolent crimes committed by juveniles in Fiera occur between 3 PM. and 8 P.M.
opts.cn: F的青少年非暴力犯罪大多发生在下午 3 点到晚上 8 点之间。

opts.t: The overall rate of violent crime in Fiera has gone up slightly over the past two years.
opts.cn: 在过去两年中，F市的暴力犯罪率略有上升。

opts.t: After varying around an apparently stable average for several years, the number of violent crimes committed by juveniles in Fiera increased by twelve percent the year before the imposition of the curfew.
opts.cn: 几年来，F市的青少年暴力犯罪率一直在一个明显稳定的平均值上下波动，而在实施宵禁令的前一年，青少年暴力犯罪率上升了 12%。

opts.t: Over the last two years, the city of Fiera has substantially increased the size of its police department and made some changes in the crime-fighting tactics the police use.
opts.cn: 在过去两年里，F市大幅增加了警察局的规模，并对警方打击犯罪的策略进行了一些调整。

opts.t: Over the past two years, fewer juveniles have been arrested in Fiera for curfew violations than have been arrested for violent crimes.
opts.cn: 在过去两年中，F市因违反宵禁令而被捕的青少年人数少于因暴力犯罪而被捕的青少年人数。

qs.label: D
qs.why:
背景：为了减少青少年暴力犯罪的数量，F市实行了宵禁。
证据：在实施宵禁后的两年里，F市青少年暴力犯罪的数量几乎下降了 10%。
结论：宵禁能有效减少青少年暴力犯罪。

D选项最能削弱文章中提到的论证，因为它提供了另一种可能的解释：青少年暴力犯罪率下降可能是由于警力的增加和警察使用的犯罪对策的变化，而不一定是因为实施宵禁。D选项表明，宵禁的实际效果可能被其他因素的影响所掩盖。

其他选项：
The majority of nonviolent crimes committed by juveniles in Fiera occur between 3 PM. and 8 P.M.
这个选项虽然提供了青少年非暴力犯罪的时间信息，但对于是否削弱宵禁减少暴力犯罪的有效性并无直接影响。
The overall rate of violent crime in Fiera has gone up slightly over the past two years.
虽然这个选项说明了整体暴力犯罪率上升，但它并没有直接反驳宵禁对青少年暴力犯罪的影响，因为整体犯罪率可能包括成人犯罪。
After varying around an apparently stable average for several years, the number of violent crimes committed by juveniles in Fiera increased by twelve percent the year before the imposition of the curfew.
这个信息提供了宵禁实施前犯罪率的上升趋势，可能暗示宵禁有效，因为在实施后犯罪率有所下降。
Over the past two years, fewer juveniles have been arrested in Fiera for curfew violations than have been arrested for violent crimes.
这个选项提供了宵禁违规逮捕和暴力犯罪逮捕的比较，但没有直接质疑宵禁减少暴力犯罪的有效性。

html: Centuries ago, the Maya of Central America produced elaborate, deeply cut carvings in stone. The carvings would have required a cutting tool of hard stone or metal. Deposits of iron ore exist throughout Central America, but apparently the Maya never developed the technology to use them and the metals the Maya are known to have used, copper and gold, would not have been hard enough. Therefore, the Maya must have used stone tools to make these carvings.
zh:
①几个世纪前，中美洲的玛雅人在石头上制作了精美的深切割雕刻。
②这些雕刻需要用坚硬的石头或金属制成的切割工具。
③中美洲各地都有铁矿，但玛雅人显然从未开发出使用铁矿的技术，而且玛雅人已知使用过的金属（铜和金）硬度不够。
④因此，玛雅人必须使用石器来制作这些雕刻。

qs.stem: Which of the following, if true, most seriously weakens the argument?
qs.zh: 以下哪项如果为真，会最严重地削弱这一论证？

opts.t: In various parts of the world, civilizations that could not make iron from ore fashioned tools out of fragments of iron from meteorites.
opts.cn: 在世界各地，无法用矿石制造铁器的文明用陨石中的铁碎片制造工具。

opts.t: All the metallic Mayan artifacts that have been found by archeologists are made of metals that are too soft for carving stone.
opts.cn: 考古学家发现的所有玛雅金属工艺品都是用太软的金属制成的，无法雕刻石头。

opts.t: The stone out of which these carvings were made is harder than the stone used by other Central American people.
opts.cn: 制作这些雕刻品的石头比其他中美洲人使用的石头更坚硬。

opts.t: The technique that the Maya used to smelt gold and some other metals could not have been easily applied to the task of extracting iron from ore.
opts.cn: 玛雅人用来冶炼黄金和其他一些金属的技术不可能轻易地用于从矿石中提取铁的任务。

opts.t: Archeologists disagree about how certain stone tools that have been found among Mayan ruins were used.
opts.cn: 考古学家对在玛雅遗址中发现的某些石器的使用方法存在分歧。

qs.label: A
qs.why:
背景：中美洲的玛雅人在石头上制作了精美的深切割雕刻。
证据：这些雕刻需要用坚硬的石头或金属制成的切割工具。玛雅人从未开发出使用铁矿的技术，而且玛雅人已知使用过的金属（铜和金）硬度不够。
结论：玛雅人必须使用石器来制作这些雕刻。

A选项提供了另一种可能性，即玛雅人可能使用了来自陨石的铁碎片来制作切割工具，而不是局限于使用石头工具。这个信息直接挑战了原论证——玛雅人没有铁质工具，因此必须使用石质工具进行雕刻。

其他选项：
All the metallic Mayan artifacts that have been found by archeologists are made of metals that are too soft for carving stone.
这个选项实际上支持了原论点，说明玛雅人使用的金属工具不适合石雕，从而间接支持玛雅人使用了石头工具的说法。
The stone out of which these carvings were made is harder than the stone used by other Central American people.
这个选项并不影响论点的有效性，它只是说明玛雅人使用的石材较硬，但不解释他们用什么工具进行雕刻。
The technique that the Maya used to smelt gold and some other metals could not have been easily applied to the task of extracting iron from ore.
这个选项说明了为何玛雅人没有使用铁质工具，但并不直接反驳他们可能使用的是石质工具或其他形式的铁质工具（如陨石铁）。
Archeologists disagree about how certain stone tools that have been found among Mayan ruins were used.
这个选项没有明确提供反对论点的直接证据，它只表明对于某些石器的用途存在不同看法，但没有具体说明这些工具是否用于石雕。

html: Tea is rich in compounds called polyphenols, which are similar to certain compounds known to help prevent cancer. Among people in Japan, those who drink over ten cups of tea per day have lower rates of stomach cancer than others. On average, people in Japan drink much more tea than people in the United States and have lower rates of lung cancer. It is therefore likely that polyphenols also help prevent cancer.
zh:
①茶叶中富含一种叫做茶多酚的化合物，这种化合物与某些已知有助于预防癌症的化合物相似。
②在日本，每天饮茶十杯以上的人患胃癌的比例低于其他人。
③日本人平均饮茶量远高于美国人，但肺癌发病率较低。
④因此，茶多酚也可能有助于预防癌症。

qs.stem: Which of the following, if true, provides the most support for the argument?
qs.zh: 如果以下哪项为真，最能支持这一论证？

opts.t: Smoking, a known cause of lung cancer, is more common in Japan than it is in the United states.
opts.cn: 众所周知，吸烟是导致肺癌的原因之一，但日本的吸烟率高于美国。

opts.t: Few people in the United States drink more than ten cups of tea per day.
opts.cn: 美国很少有人每天喝茶超过十杯。

opts.t: Stomach cancer is much more common in Japan than it is in the United States.
opts.cn: 胃癌在日本比在美国更常见。

opts.t: Soy products, which are known to help prevent cancer, are more widely used in Japan than in the United States.
opts.cn: 众所周知，大豆制品有助于预防癌症，但日本比美国更广泛地使用大豆制品。

opts.t: Coffee, which like tea is a source of caffeine, is more popular in the United States than in Japan.
opts.cn: 咖啡和茶一样都是咖啡因的来源，在美国比在日本更受欢迎。

qs.label: A
qs.why:
证据：茶叶中富含一种叫做茶多酚的化合物，这种化合物与某些已知有助于预防癌症的化合物相似。在日本，每天饮茶十杯以上的人患胃癌的比例低于其他人。日本人平均饮茶量远高于美国人，但肺癌发病率较低。
结论：茶多酚也可能有助于预防癌症。

A选项考虑到吸烟是肺癌的一个已知原因，如果日本的吸烟率比美国更高，但是日本的肺癌发病率却更低，那么这强化了茶（特别是茶中的多酚化合物）可能对预防肺癌有积极影响的论证。这是因为，尽管有更高的吸烟率（这应该会增加肺癌风险），但如果肺癌发病率却相对较低，那么这表明还有其他因素在起作用，茶的消费可能就是这样一个积极的因素。这一信息增加了结论成立的可能性。

其他选项：
Few people in the United States drink more than ten cups of tea per day.
这只是说明美国人喝茶较少，但并未提供新的信息来支持多酚预防癌症的论点。它没有解释为什么多酚有预防癌症的作用。
Stomach cancer is much more common in Japan than it is in the United States.
如果日本的胃癌发病率更高，尽管他们喝更多的茶，这可能 削弱 了茶预防癌症的论点。
Soy products, which are known to help prevent cancer, are more widely used in Japan than in the United States.
这提供了另一个可能的原因来解释日本较低的癌症发病率，即 豆制品。这会 削弱 文章中关于多酚的论点，因为降低癌症发病率的原因可能是豆制品，而非茶。
Coffee, which like tea is a source of caffeine, is more popular in the United States than in Japan.
咖啡的流行程度与多酚预防癌症的论点无直接关联。并且，咖啡主要提供咖啡因，而非多酚，因此无法支持文章的论点。

html: Belnovia’s government provides health care to all its citizens Five years ago, with costs incurred from smoking-related health problems accounting for 5 percent of annual government expenditures, Belnovia’s health agency initiated a nationwide antismoking campaign. Although the campaign succeeded in reducing the number of smokers in Belnovia substantially, it clearly failed to reduce the annual costs incurred from smoking-related health problems, since these costs currently account for 6 percent of annual government expenditures.
zh:
①B政府为所有公民提供医疗保健。
②五年前，B的卫生机构发起了一场全国性的禁烟运动，那时与吸烟相关的健康问题所产生的费用占政府年度支出的5%。
③尽管该运动成功地大幅减少了B的吸烟者人数，但显然未能减少与吸烟相关的健康问题每年产生的费用，因为这些费用目前占政府年度支出的6%。

qs.stem: Which of the following is an assumption on which the argument depends?
qs.zh: 以下哪个是该论证所依赖的假设？

opts.t: Costs incurred from smoking-related health problems account for a greater portion of the Belnovian government’s overall health expenditures now than they did five years ago.
opts.cn: 吸烟相关健康问题导致的费用占比比五年前B政府整体健康支出的比例更大。

opts.t: The average cost of treatment for smoking related health problems in Belnovia has not increased significantly over the past five years.
opts.cn: 在过去五年中，B吸烟相关健康问题的治疗平均费用并没有显著增加。

opts.t: Overall health expenditure account for a greater portion of the Belnovian government’s annual expenditures now than they did five years’ ago.
opts.cn: 现在，B政府年度支出中整体健康支出的比例比五年前更大。

opts.t: Belnovia’s annual government expenditures are not significantly lower now than they were five years ago.
opts.cn: B政府的年度支出现在与五年前相比并没有显著降低。

opts.t: Smoking-related health problems usually persist long after a person has quit smoking.
opts.cn: 吸烟相关的健康问题通常在一个人戒烟后仍会持续存在。

qs.label: D
qs.why:
5 年前：吸烟相关健康问题的花费 = 政府年度总支出的 5%
现在：吸烟相关健康问题的花费 = 政府年度总支出的 6%
结论：戒烟活动 显然没能减少吸烟相关健康问题的年度花费。

即使分子变小了，只要分母下降得更厉害，百分比也可以从 5% 变成 6%。仅仅看到百分比从 5% → 6%，并不能直接得出“钱没减少”的结论。要让作者的结论成立，必须有一个隐藏前提：政府年度总支出没有明显减少。选 D选项。

其他选项：

html: Along one part of California’s San Andreas Fault, the land sometimes shifts slightly. Some researchers hypothesize that such shifts occur a few days before virtually all earthquakes measuring above 3.3 on the Richter scale of magnitude. Therefore, if these researchers are right, and if such shifts can be reliably detected when they occur, then it is possible to predict, merely by watching for shifts, whether such an earthquake will occur within a few days.
zh:
①沿着加州SA断层的一部分，陆地有时会轻微移动。
②一些研究人员猜想这种变化发生在几乎所有里氏3.3级以上地震的前几天。
③因此，如果这些研究人员是正确的，如果这种变化在发生时能够被可靠地检测到，那么仅仅通过观察这种变化就有可能预测这种地震是否会在几天内发生。

qs.stem: The argument is most vulnerable to which of the following criticisms?
qs.zh: 该论证最容易被以下哪一项攻击？

opts.t: It does not take into account that slight shifts and earthquakes of magnitude 3.3 or greater might both be caused by some third factor.
opts.cn: 它没有考虑到轻微的位移和3.3级或更大的地震都可能是由第三个因素引起的。

opts.t: It treats one particular indicator of earthquakes of a given magnitude as if it were the only such indicator.
opts.cn: 它将某一震级地震的一个特定标志视为唯一此类标志。

opts.t: It mistakes evidence that earthquakes of a given magnitude can be predicted for evidence that all earthquakes can be predicted.
opts.cn: 它错误地把某一震级的地震可以预测的证据当作所有地震都可以预测的证据。

opts.t: It fails to establish that the shifts can be reliably predicted.
opts.cn: 无法确定能够可靠地预测位移。

opts.t: The evidence offered is consistent with the majority of shifts’ not being followed by an earthquake.
opts.cn: 所提供的证据与大多数陆地移动之后没有发生地震是一致的。

qs.label: E
qs.why:
背景: 沿着加州SA断层的一部分，陆地有时会轻微移动。
证据: 几乎所有里氏3.3级以上地震的前几天都会发生陆地移动(一些研究人员猜想)。
结论: (如果这些研究人员是正确的，如果这种变化在发生时能够被可靠地检测到) 靠观察陆地移动变化就有可能预测这种地震是否会在几天内发生。

几乎所有地震之前有陆地移动，那么是否所有陆地移动之后都发生了地震呢? 如果大部分移动之后其实没发生地震，那根据移动推断地震就很困难。E选项说, 证据能表明大多数陆地移动之后没有发生地震, 削弱了原文论证。

其他选项：
It does not take into account that slight shifts and earthquakes of magnitude 3.3 or greater might both be caused by some third factor.
虽然可能存在第三因素，但预测地震的有效性不依赖于是否有共同原因，只要 shift 始终先于地震就能当信号。这个不是最直接的漏洞。

It treats one particular indicator of earthquakes of a given magnitude as if it were the only such indicator.
论证没有声称这是“唯一”的指标，只是说“可以通过它预测”，不涉及“唯一性”的错误。

It mistakes evidence that earthquakes of a given magnitude can be predicted for evidence that all earthquakes can be predicted.
没有说“所有地震”，限定的是“3.3级以上”，所以没有这种扩大化的错误。

It fails to establish that the shifts can be reliably predicted.
题干里明确加了条件 “if such shifts can be reliably detected”，已经承认了需要可靠探测，不是没考虑。

html: A certain strikingly colorful parrot whose habitat today is restricted to a few regions of South America is depicted in a 1,300-year-old Mayan mural painted on a palace wall in what is now Mexico. Although the parrot's depiction is so accurate and evocative that the artist must have been thoroughly familiar with the bird, the mural by itself provides no compelling evidence that this species' habitat ever extended into North America as far as Mexico, since______.
zh:
①在现在的墨西哥，一幅1300年前的玛雅壁画上描绘了一只色彩鲜艳的鹦鹉，它的栖息地现在仅限于南美洲的几个地区。
②虽然鹦鹉的描绘是如此准确和令人回味，艺术家一定已经完全熟悉这种鸟，壁画本身并没有提供令人信服的证据，证明这种物种的栖息地曾经延伸到北美，直到墨西哥，因为______。

qs.stem: Which of the following most logically completes the argument?
qs.zh: 以下哪项最符合逻辑地补全了论证？

opts.t: 1300 years ago there was regular trade among the Mayans of Mexico and the inhabitants of several regions of South America
opts.cn: 1300年前，墨西哥的玛雅人和南美洲几个地区的居民之间有着正常的贸易往来

opts.t: no other murals from the same time period that depict this species of parrot have been found in Mexico
opts.cn: 在墨西哥还没有发现其他同一时期描绘这种鹦鹉的壁画

opts.t: the mural also depicts a species of parrot that is common in Mexico today
opts.cn: 这幅壁画还描绘了一种鹦鹉，这种鹦鹉现在在墨西哥很常见

opts.t: there are no tropical forests in Mexico today that could provide a habitat for the parrot
opts.cn: 现在墨西哥没有热带森林可以为鹦鹉提供栖息地

opts.t: of all the animals and birds that are depicted in the mural, this parrot is the only one that does not inhabit Mexico today
opts.cn: 在壁画中描绘的所有动物和鸟类中，这只鹦鹉是唯一一只不在墨西哥居住的鹦鹉

qs.label: A
qs.why:
空格需要填入一个理由, 说明为什么虽然墨西哥的壁画上出现了鹦鹉, 但是这无法证明墨西哥曾经是鹦鹉的栖息地。
A选项说墨西哥的玛雅人和南美洲几个地区的居民有贸易往来, 说明鹦鹉可能是通过人们的商贸被带到了墨西哥, 而不是鹦鹉的栖息地从南美洲延伸到了墨西哥。

其他选项：
no other murals from the same time period that depict this species of parrot have been found in Mexico
强调其他壁画中没有这种鹦鹉的描绘，并不能说明该物种的栖息地是否曾延伸到墨西哥。
the mural also depicts a species of parrot that is common in Mexico today
壁画中还有其他鹦鹉种类，并不解释为何精确描绘的南美鹦鹉不一定说明其曾在墨西哥栖息。
there are no tropical forests in Mexico today that could provide a habitat for the parrot
这个选项涉及现代的情况，无法说明1300年前的栖息地分布。
of all the animals and birds that are depicted in the mural, this parrot is the only one that does not inhabit Mexico today
该鹦鹉今天不在墨西哥，无法解释为何其历史上可能没有在墨西哥栖息，与定期贸易相比缺乏解释力。

html: Growing grapes in greenhouses containing air enriched with carbon dioxide increases crop yields, an effect that is enhanced when the growing temperature is also raised several degrees. Although enclosed cultivation is impractical in vineyards, increases in yields from grape cultivation in the open can be expected because emissions from the burning of fossil fuels will almost certainly lead to an increase in the carbon dioxide content of atmospheric air over the next century.
zh:
①在空气中富含二氧化碳的温室中种植葡萄可以提高作物产量，如果种植温度也提高几度，效果会更好。
②虽然在葡萄园中进行封闭式栽培并不现实，但由于化石燃料燃烧产生的废气几乎肯定会在下个世纪导致大气中二氧化碳含量的增加，因此在露天栽培葡萄的产量有望提高。

qs.stem: Which of the following, if true, most weakens the argument?
qs.zh: 如果以下哪项为真，最能削弱这一论证？

opts.t: When grapes are grown in greenhouses, it is relatively easy to control the grape pests that thrive in air enriched with carbon dioxide.
opts.cn: 在温室中种植葡萄，相对容易控制在富含二氧化碳的空气中茁壮成长的葡萄害虫。

opts.t: Recent improvements in pest control have increased grape yields in many vineyards.
opts.cn: 最近在害虫控制方面的改进提高了许多葡萄园的葡萄产量。

opts.t: Increasing carbon dioxide levels in greenhouses has not been shown to improve the quality  of grapes grown in greenhouses.
opts.cn: 提高温室中的二氧化碳含量并不能改善温室葡萄的质量。

opts.t: Increasing carbon dioxide levels in greenhouses increases the sweetness of raisins made from grapes grown in the greenhouses.
opts.cn: 提高温室中的二氧化碳含量会增加用温室中种植的葡萄制成的葡萄干的甜度。

opts.t: As the carbon dioxide level in the open air increases, temperatures at the Earth's surface will also increase.
opts.h: As the carbon dioxide level in the open air increases, temperatures at the Earth's surface will also increase.
opts.cn: 随着露天空气中二氧化碳含量的增加，地球表面的温度也会升高。

qs.label: A
qs.why:
证据：在空气中富含二氧化碳的温室中种植葡萄可以提高作物产量，如果种植温度也提高几度，效果会更好。化石燃料燃烧产生的废气几乎肯定会在下个世纪导致大气中二氧化碳含量的增加。
结论：在露天栽培葡萄的产量有望提高。

A选项说在温室生长的时候，容易控制害虫，所以如果露天栽培葡萄，害虫可能导致葡萄产量的下降。

html: In 1995 , most new cars priced below $10,000 were sold to young people buying their first factory-new car Parents buying a car for a son or a daughter were the second-largest group of buyers. In 1995 every factory-new car priced below $10,000 was a subcompact car. Primarily because parents who buy subcompacts for a son or a daughter are highly safety-conscious, all factory-new subcompact cars available in 1995 came with air bags for both front seats.
zh:
①1995 年，大多数售价低于 10,000 美元的新车都卖给了购买第一辆新车的年轻人，为儿子或女儿买车的父母是第二大购车群体。
②1995 年，每辆售价低于 10,000 美元的新车都是超小型汽车。
③主要是因为为儿子或女儿购买超小型汽车的父母具有很强的安全意识，所以 1995 年出厂的所有超小型汽车的前排座椅都配备了安全气囊。

qs.stem: If the information provided is true, which of the following must also be true about 1995 on the basis of it?
qs.zh: 如果所提供的信息是真实的，那么根据该信息，下列关于 1995 年的哪项也一定是真实的？

opts.t: Most factory-new subcompact cars were priced below$10 , 000
opts.h: Most factory-new subcompact cars were priced below$10 , 000
opts.cn: 大多数新出厂的超小型汽车售价低于 10,000 美元

opts.t: Most parents buying a car for a son or a daughter purchased a factory-new subcompact car.
opts.cn: 大多数为儿子或女儿买车的父母购买的是出厂的全新超小型汽车。

opts.t: No parents buying a car for a son or a daughter purchased a factory-new car that did not come with air bags for both front seats.
opts.cn: 为儿女买车的父母中，没有人购买前排座椅不配备安全气囊的出厂新车。

opts.t: Some young people who bought their first factory-new car bought a car that came with air bags for both front seats.
opts.cn: 一些首次购买新车的年轻人购买的汽车前排两个座位都配备了安全气囊。

opts.t: More new cars were purchased by young people buying their first factory-new car than by parents buying a car for a son or a daughter.
opts.cn: 购买第一辆全新汽车的年轻人所买的新车，比父母为子女购买的新车更多。

qs.label: D
qs.why:
文中提到，1995年所有定价低于10,000美元的全新车都是次级紧凑型车。
又提到，所有1995年可购买的全新次级紧凑型车都配备了前排双气囊。
综合上述信息，任何购买了价格低于$10,000的新车的人，都买到了配有前排双气囊的车。而1995年大多数新车低于$10,000的购买者是首次购买全新车的年轻人，因此一些年轻人购买的全新车配备了前排双气囊，选D选项。

其他选项：
Most factory-new subcompact cars were priced below $10,000
题干只说“所有 <$10 000 的车都是微型车”，但没说“所有微型车都 <$10 000”，也没给出各价位销量比例。

Most parents buying a car for a son or a daughter purchased a factory-new subcompact car.
父母也可能大量购买价位更高的车型，题干没有提供父母整体购车分布。

No parents buying a car for a son or a daughter purchased a factory-new car that did not come with air bags for both front seats.
父母可以买非微型车（可能没有双气囊）。题干只说了“微型车有气囊”，并没限制父母不买其他车型。

More new cars were purchased by young people buying their first factory-new car than by parents buying a car for a son or a daughter.
我们只知道在 <$10 000 价格段年轻人数量多于父母，但无法确定在全价位市场上的总体数量对比。

html: Mayor: Vehicle exhaust produces dangerously high ozone levels in our city in hot, humid weather. As an incentive for people to commute by bus rather than by car, special free commuter buses will be scheduled on hot, humid days. Since a bus can carry about 40 people but produces only about 20 times as much exhaust as a car, ozone levels will be lower as long as the buses are more than half full.
zh:
①市长：在炎热潮湿的天气里，汽车尾气会在我们的城市中产生高浓度的臭氧。 
②为了鼓励人们乘公共汽车而不是开车上下班，特殊的免费通勤巴士将安排在炎热和潮湿的日子。 
③由于一辆公共汽车可以载人40人，但产生的废气却仅是汽车的20倍，因此只要公共汽车的载客量超过一半，臭氧水平就会降低。

qs.stem: Which of the following, if true, most seriously weakens the argument?
qs.zh: 以下哪一项，如果是真的，最严重地削弱了论证？

opts.t: Most of the people who would take the special free buses are currently members of carpools.
opts.cn: 大多数会乘坐免费巴士的人是目前的拼车族。

opts.t: The city does not currently have enough buses to transport all of the commuters who normally commute by car.
opts.cn: 该市目前没有足够的公共汽车来运送所有通常开车上下班的通勤者。

opts.t: Buses that would be operating on hot, humid days would rarely, if ever, be filled to capacity.
opts.cn: 在炎热、潮湿的日子里行驶的公共汽车很少能满载。

opts.t: The amount of vehicle exhaust produced in the city is not significantly higher on hot, humid days.
opts.cn: 在炎热、潮湿的日子里，城市产生的汽车尾气量并不明显较高。

opts.t: Not all commuter routes are used by enough people to warrant providing bus service for them.
opts.cn: 并非所有的通勤路线都有足够多的人，来保证能够为他们提供巴士服务。

qs.label: A
qs.why:
背景信息: 在炎热潮湿的天气里，汽车尾气会产生高浓度的臭氧。在炎热和潮湿的日子, 有免费的通勤巴士。
证据: 一辆公共汽车可以载人40人，但产生的废气却仅是汽车的20倍。
结论: 只要公共汽车的载客量超过一半，臭氧水平就会降低。

在湿热天下下，巴士能装40人，但是产生的尾气只有汽车的20倍。根据数学计算的话，如果每个汽车都坐2个人的话，巴士和汽车的尾气排放效果就相等了。如果来坐公交的人都是以前拼车的人，那么实际上反而增加了尾气的排放了。（例如以前4个人共享一个汽车，现在都去坐公交）。

html: During the spring months of last year, 510 drivers who were stopped by Fisk County's police and given breath tests failed the tests, having blood-alcohol levels above the legal limit for driving. This spring, after a vigorous advertising campaign against driving while intoxicated, only 320 drivers failed the tests. It cannot be concluded, however, that the campaign was responsible for the decrease because the breath tests were administered to far fewer individuals this spring than last spring.
zh:
①去年春季，F县警方拦截并对司机进行了呼气测试，结果有 510 名司机未能通过测试，其血液中的酒精含量超过了驾车的法定限度。
②今年春季，在大力开展禁止酒后驾车的宣传活动后，只有 320 名司机未能通过测试。
③但是，由于今年春季进行呼气测试的人数远远少于去年春季，因此不能断定未通过呼气测试人数的减少是宣传活动造成的。

qs.stem: Which of the following, if true, most seriously weakens the argument?
qs.zh: 如果以下哪项为真，最能削弱这一论点？

opts.t: Between last spring and this spring,the legal limit of blood alcohol for driving in Fisk County remained unchanged.
opts.cn: 从去年春季到今年春季，F县驾车时血液中的法定酒精浓度保持不变。

opts.t: In Fisk County, breath tests are administered only to drivers whose behavior makes police suspect that they are intoxicated.
opts.cn: 在F县，只有当司机的行为让警方怀疑其醉酒时，才会对其进行呼气测试。

opts.t: The police of Fisk County do not generally test drivers for any intoxicating substances other than alcohol.
opts.cn: F县警方一般不对司机进行除酒精以外的任何其他致醉物质检测。

opts.t: A similar advertising campaign conducted ten years ago was credited with temporarily reducing the incidence of driving while intoxicated.
opts.cn: 十年前开展的类似广告宣传活动暂时降低了醉酒驾驶的发生率。

opts.t: The number of police patrolling Fisk County's roads and highways was significantly lower this spring than last spring.
opts.h: The number of police patrolling Fisk County's roads and highways was significantly lower this spring than last spring.
opts.cn: 今年春季在F县道路和高速公路上巡逻的警察人数明显少于去年春季。

qs.label: B
qs.why:
背景信息：去年春季，有 510 名司机未能通过测；今年春季，在大力开展禁止酒后驾车的宣传活动后，只有 320 名司机未能通过测试。
证据：今年春季进行呼气测试的人数远远少于去年春季。
结论：不能断定未通过呼气测试人数的减少是宣传活动造成的。

原论证质疑宣传活动对减少驾驶员血液酒精超标的效果，理由是今年春季进行呼气测试的人数远少于去年春季。如果呼气测试仅针对行为表现让警察怀疑醉酒的司机，那么即使测试的总人数减少，实际上血液酒精超标的驾驶员比例下降仍然可以指向宣传活动的有效性。因为这意味着宣传活动可能使得真正醉酒驾驶的人数减少，从而行为表现让警察怀疑醉酒的司机人数也减少。

其他选项：
Between last spring and this spring, the legal limit of blood alcohol for driving in Fisk County remained unchanged.（去年春季和今年春季，F县驾驶时血液酒精的法定限值保持不变。）这个信息虽然相关，但它不影响论证的结论，因为它没有直接回应宣传活动的有效性。
The police of Fisk County do not generally test drivers for any intoxicating substances other than alcohol.（F县的警察通常不对驾驶员进行除酒精外的其他致醉物质检测。）这一信息与宣传活动的效果无直接关联。
A similar advertising campaign conducted ten years ago was credited with temporarily reducing the incidence of driving while intoxicated.（十年前进行的类似宣传活动曾被认为暂时减少了醉酒驾驶的发生率。）这个信息可能稍微支持宣传活动的有效性，但无法削弱论证对此次宣传效果提出的质疑。
The number of police patrolling Fisk County's roads and highways was significantly lower this spring than last spring.（今年春季在F县道路和高速公路巡逻的警察数量明显少于去年春季。）这一信息可能解释了为什么进行测试的人数减少，但不直接解释宣传活动效果的减弱或增强。

html: Some recently discovered Hittite tablets corroborate many of the descriptions of ancient life that appear in the Iliad and even list Greek cities that reportedly sent ships to Troy. What this find entails is that the Iliad is not simply creative literature, as is commonly believed, and hence not a matter for literary discussion alone. Rather, it is also history and should be examined by historical science.
zh:
①最近发现的一些H石碑证实了I中出现的许多关于古代生活的描述，甚至还列出了据说曾派船前往特洛伊的希腊城市。
②这一发现表明，I并不像人们普遍认为的那样只是一部文学创作作品，因此也不仅仅是文学讨论的问题。
③相反，它也是历史，应该由历史科学来研究。

qs.stem: The argument given relies on which of the following as an assumption?
qs.zh: 所给出的论证依赖于以下哪项假设？

opts.t: The cities and events that were mentioned in the Iliad but not in the tablets are fictitious.
opts.cn: I中提到但石碑中没有提到的城市和事件是虚构的。

opts.t: The Hittite tablets and the Iliad are not derived from a common source that had no basis in historical fact.
opts.cn: H石碑和I并非来自一个没有史实依据的共同来源。

opts.t: Before the discovery of the tablets, historians had never examined the Iliad.
opts.cn: 在发现石碑之前，历史学家从未研究过I。

opts.t: Purported works of creative literature should be examined by historians to find out whether they record historical facts.
opts.cn: 历史学家应该对所谓的文学创作作品进行研究，以确定它们是否记录了历史事实。

opts.t: A work that does not contain historical facts is a mater for literary discussion
opts.cn: 不包含历史事实的作品是文学讨论的素材。

qs.label: B
qs.why:
证据：最近发现的一些H石碑证实了I中出现的许多关于古代生活的描述。
结论：I不仅仅是文学讨论的问题，它也是历史，应该由历史科学来研究。

B选项支持了发现的H碑文与Iliad之间的直接关联，并假设这些碑文中的信息与Iliad是独立的历史证据，而不是源自同一个虚构的来源。这一点对于结论Iliad不仅仅是创意文学，同时还包含了历史事实，从而应当由历史科学来研究，是必要的。

其他选项：
The cities and events that were mentioned in the Iliad but not in the tablets are fictitious.
这个选项并非必需的假设，因为主张并不依赖于那些未在碑文中出现的城市或事件是否虚构。
Before the discovery of the tablets, historians had never examined the Iliad.
这也不是必需的假设。论证的有效性不取决于此前历史学家是否研究过Iliad。
Purported works of creative literature should be examined by historians to find out whether they record historical facts.
尽管这与论证的结论类似，但这不是一个必要假设。这是一个更广泛的主张，而不是特定于这个论证的基础。
A work that does not contain historical facts is a matter for literary discussion.
这也不是必需的假设，因为即使一个作品包含了历史事实，它仍然可以是文学讨论的对象。此外，这个选项与论证的焦点不符。

html: The damage that trucks do to highways escalates dramatically with the weight borne per axle. New regulations increase the maximum permitted vehicle weight; these regulations will therefore allow onto the highway trucks capable of doing even more damage than those currently permitted.
zh:
① 卡车对高速公路造成的损坏在每轴承载的重量增加时急剧升级。
② 新规定提高了允许的最大车辆重量；因此，这些规定将允许在高速公路上运行的卡车造成比当前允许的卡车更严重的破坏。

qs.stem: The argument is open up to criticism on the grounds that it
qs.zh: 这个论点容易受到批评，原因是

opts.t: fails to establish that the level of damage done by trucks is a serious problem
opts.cn: 未能证明卡车对公路造成的损坏程度是一个严重的问题

opts.t: omits evidence about one of the two relevant factors
opts.cn: 省略了关于两个相关因素之一的证据

opts.t: ignores the possibility that careful driving can lessen damage to highways
opts.cn: 忽视了谨慎驾驶可以减少对公路的损坏的可能性

opts.t: presumes that trucks are the only vehicles capable of causing substantial damage to highways
opts.cn: 假设卡车是唯一能够对公路造成重大损害的车辆

opts.t: presumes that something is bound to happen just because it is allowed to happen
opts.cn: 假设只要允许某事发生，必然会发生某种结果

qs.label: B
qs.why:
要从“车辆总重上限提高”推出“将允许更能造成损害的卡车”，需要知道每轴承重是否会上升。但“每轴承重 = 车辆总重 / 车轴数”。如果重了但加轴数，则每轴承重不一定增加。题干没有给出“轴数”或“按轴限重”的信息，漏掉了另一半关键因素。B选项描述了这个逻辑漏洞。

其他选项：
fails to establish that the level of damage done by trucks is a serious problem
是否“严重”与论证的有效性无关；论证在讨论能否推出“更能造成损害的卡车将被允许上路”，而不是“损害严不严重”。

ignores the possibility that careful driving can lessen damage to highways
题干并没以“驾驶方式”建模损害，这属于无关可能性；而且讨论的是结构性负载（每轴受重）导致的损害。

presumes that trucks are the only vehicles capable of causing substantial damage to highways
论证只讨论卡车法规，不需要比较其他车辆。无关。

presumes that something is bound to happen just because it is allowed to happen
原文结论是“will allow … trucks capable of doing even more damage”（将允许有能力造成更大损害的卡车上路），是谈能力与许可，并没有断言一定会发生更多损害。

html: Fossil evidence shows that within a century after the arrival of the first settlers on the island of Corme 16,000 years ago, the one species of kangaroo that had been thriving on Corme became extinct. Archaeologists contend that the primary cause of the kangaroo ’ s extinction was land-clearing rather than hunting. Evidence shows that the settlers burned large tracts of vegetation to clear land for cultivation, which would have greatly reduced the food available for the kangaroo.
zh:
①化石证据表明，在16,000年前第一批定居者来到C岛后的一个世纪内，在C岛上繁衍生息的一种袋鼠灭绝了。
②考古学家认为袋鼠灭绝的主要原因是土地清理而不是狩猎。
③有证据表明，定居者焚烧了大片植被来开垦土地，这会大大减少袋鼠的食物供应。

qs.stem: Which of the following, if true, provides most support for the archaeologists ’ contention?
qs.zh: 以下哪一项，如果属实，最能支持考古学家的论点？

opts.t: The fossil record on Corme shows no evidence that any other mammals disappeared in the period following the arrival of settlers.
opts.cn: C岛的化石记录显示，没有证据表明在定居者到来后的这段时间里，有任何其他哺乳动物消失了。

opts.t: At the time settlers first arrived, Corme was in the midst of a period when its climate was becoming increasingly arid and its pattern of vegetation was consequently changing.
opts.cn: 定居者初到C时，C正处于气候日益干旱、植被格局随之改变的时期。

opts.t: The earliest settlements on Corme were spread along the island's coasts.
opts.h: The earliest settlements on Corme were spread along the island's coasts.
opts.cn: C岛上最早的定居点分布在该岛的海岸线上。

opts.t: Archaeological excavation of the settlements on Corme has yielded large quantities of bones of many species of mammal and fish but very few kangaroo bones.
opts.cn: C岛定居点的考古发掘发现了大量哺乳动物和鱼类的骨头，但袋鼠的骨头很少。

opts.t: The earliest settlers on Corme cultivate food plants that they found growing wild on the island.
opts.cn: C岛上最早的定居者种植食用植物，他们发现这些植物在岛上野生生长。

qs.label: D
qs.why: 背景信息：第一批定居者来到C岛后的一个世纪内，在C岛上繁衍生息的一种袋鼠灭绝了。证据：有证据表明，定居者焚烧了大片植被来开垦土地；植被的破坏会大大减少袋鼠的食物供应。结论：袋鼠灭绝的主要原因是土地清理而不是狩猎。D选项说在定居点的考古发掘发现了大量哺乳动物和鱼类的骨头，但袋鼠的骨头很少，说明袋鼠可能不是当时人类的食物，而哺乳动物和鱼类才是。这个信息支持了结论说“袋鼠灭绝的主要原因不是狩猎”。其他选项：“The fossil record on Corme shows no evidence that any other mammals disappeared in the period following the arrival of settlers.”虽然这说明其他哺乳动物没有灭绝，但并不能支持考古学家关于袋鼠灭绝主要原因的论点。它既不能证明是土地清理导致的灭绝，也不能排除狩猎的可能性。“At the time settlers first arrived, Corme was in the midst of a period when its climate was becoming increasingly arid and its pattern of vegetation was consequently changing.”这个选项提出了气候变化作为袋鼠灭绝的另一个可能原因，实际上削弱了考古学家的观点，因为如果是气候导致植被变化，那么土地清理就不是主要原因。“The earliest settlements on Corme were spread along the island's coasts.”这个信息与袋鼠灭绝的原因无直接关联。它未提供关于土地清理或狩猎活动的信息。“The earliest settlers on Corme cultivate food plants that they found growing wild on the island.”这表明定居者利用现有植物进行耕种，可能减少了对土地清理的需求。但这并不能直接支持或反驳袋鼠灭绝的原因，也未说明他们是否进行了大量的土地清理。

html: Based on the analysis of ocean currents, some researchers predict that during the next hurricane season there will be considerably more hurricanes in the Atlantic than there are in a typical hurricane season. If these researchers are right, then the amount of hurricane damage to property in Atlantic coastal regions of North America will be much greater next hurricane season than in a typical hurricane season unless extraordinary measures are taken to protect property.
zh:
①根据对洋流的分析，一些研究人员预测，在下一个飓风季节，大西洋的飓风数量将大大超过一般的飓风季节。
②如果这些研究人员的预测是正确的，那么除非采取非常措施保护财产，否则下一个飓风季节北美大西洋沿岸地区的财产损失将比一般飓风季节大得多。

qs.stem: Which of the following is an assumption on which the argument depends?
qs.zh: 以下哪项是论证所依赖的假设？

opts.t: Any protective measures that could be taken before the next hurricane season would be insufficient to keep the amount of hurricane damage at a level much below that of a typical season.
opts.cn: 在下一个飓风季节到来之前采取的任何保护措施都不足以将飓风造成的损失控制在远低于正常飓风季节的水平。

opts.t: Analysis of ocean currents such as that undertaken by the researchers is the most reliable means of predicting the frequency of hurricanes.
opts.cn: 像研究人员所做的洋流分析是预测飓风频率的最可靠手段。

opts.t: When the number of hurricanes in the Atlantic is greater than in a typical year, those hurricanes are typically stronger than usual.
opts.cn: 当大西洋中的飓风数量多于一般年份时，这些飓风通常会比平常更强。

opts.t: The circumstances that are predicted to cause an unusually large number of hurricanes are not circumstances that tend to keep hurricanes away from the North American coast.
opts.cn: 据预测，导致飓风数量异常多的情况并不是飓风倾向于远离北美海岸的情况。

opts.t: Few additional precautions will be taken before the next hurricane season.
opts.cn: 在下一个飓风季节到来之前，几乎不会采取额外的预防措施。

qs.label: D
qs.why:
证据： 基于对洋流的分析，一些研究人员预测，下一次飓风季节，大西洋的飓风数量将比典型飓风季节多得多。
结论： 如果这些研究人员是正确的，那么除非采取非常措施来保护财产，否则北美大西洋沿岸地区的财产飓风损失将在下一个飓风季节比典型飓风季节大得多。

要找到论证依赖的假设，即隐含的前提。
论证的结论是，如果大西洋的飓风数量增加，北美大西洋沿岸地区的财产损失将大大增加。这基于一个假设：更多的飓风将影响北美海岸。如果导致飓风数量增加的条件实际上会使飓风远离北美海岸，那么即使飓风数量增加，也不会导致财产损失增加。因此，论证依赖于D选项描述的假设。

html: The only physical evidence that the Norse reached North America around A.D. 1000 are the ruins of a single Norse settlement at L' Anse aux Meadows in Newfoundland. It is clear, however, that the Norse must at least have explored much farther south: found among remnants left by the Norse at the settlement site were nuts from the butternut tree, a North American tree that grew no farther north than several hundred miles south of L' Anse aux Meadows.
zh:
①北欧人在公元 1000 年左右到达北美洲的唯一实物证据是纽芬兰 L' Anse aux Meadows 的一处北欧人定居点遗址。
②不过，很明显，北欧人至少应该在更南的地方进行过探索：在北欧人在定居点留下的遗迹中发现了山丁子树的坚果，而这种北美树木的生长范围至少在L' Anse aux Meadows 以南几百英里外。

qs.stem: Which of the following is an assumption on which the argument relies?
qs.zh: 以下哪项是论证所依据的假设？

opts.t: There were no Norse settlements farther south than L' Anse aux Meadows.
opts.h: There were no Norse settlements farther south than L' Anse aux Meadows.
opts.cn: 在比 L' Anse aux Meadows 更南的地方没有北欧人的定居点。

opts.t: The viability of the settlement depended on acquiring food from more southerly regions.
opts.cn: 定居点的生存取决于从更南边的地区获取食物。

opts.t: The Norse settlers did not trade with native peoples of the area for goods from the south.
opts.cn: 北欧定居者并没有与该地区的原住民进行贸易，从南方获取物资。

opts.t: It was the harsh, northern climate at L' Anse aux Meadows that caused the Norse to abandon the settlement there.
opts.h: It was the harsh, northern climate at L' Anse aux Meadows that caused the Norse to abandon the settlement there.
opts.cn: 正是 L' Anse aux Meadows 恶劣的北方气候导致北欧人放弃在那里定居。

opts.t: The only kind of nut found among remnants left by the Norse at the settlement site were butternuts.
opts.cn: 在北欧人留在定居点的遗迹中，只发现了一种坚果，那就是山丁子。

qs.label: C
qs.why:
背景：北欧人在公元 1000 年左右到达北美洲的唯一实物证据是纽芬兰 L' Anse aux Meadows 的一处北欧人定居点遗址。
证据：在北欧人在定居点留下的遗迹中发现了山丁子树的坚果，而这种北美树木的生长范围至少在L' Anse aux Meadows 以南几百英里外。（这种树木生长的最北边界在比L' Anse aux Meadows南几百英里的地方。）
结论：北欧人至少应该在更南的地方进行过探索。

C 选项假设北欧人没有和当地的原住民进行交易来获取南方的物品。如果北欧人曾通过交易从更南的地区获得了山丁子，那么他们不需要亲自前往更南的地区。那么，推论出他们确实探索了更南的地区就无法成立。因此，这个选项是论证成立所必需的假设。

其他选项：
There were no Norse settlements farther south than L' Anse aux Meadows.
即使在更南的地方有北欧人的定居点，论证依然成立。
The viability of the settlement depended on acquiring food from more southerly regions.
这个选项与论证的结论无关，结论是关于探索的范围，而不是定居点的生存条件。
It was the harsh, northern climate at L' Anse aux Meadows that caused the Norse to abandon the settlement there.
这是关于定居点被遗弃原因的假设，而非论证所需的前提条件。
The only kind of nut found among remnants left by the Norse at the settlement site were butternuts.
即使有其他种类的坚果被发现，也不能推翻北欧人探索更南区域的推论。

html: An alarming number of Mediterranean monk seals,  an endangered species, have  recently died. Postmortem analysis showed the presence of an as yet unidentified virus, as well as evidence of a know bacterial toxin. Seawater samples from the area where the seals died did contain unusually high concentrations of the toxic bacterium. Therefore, although both viruses and bacterial toxins can kill seals, it is more likely that these deaths were the result of the bacterial toxin.
zh:
①地中海濒危物种m海豹最近死亡的数量令人震惊。
②死后分析表明，海豹体内存在一种尚未查明的病毒以及一种已知的细菌毒素。
③海豹死亡海域的海水样本中确实含有异常高浓度的有毒细菌。
④因此，尽管病毒和细菌毒素都能杀死海豹，但这些死亡更可能是细菌毒素造成的。

qs.stem: Which of the following, if true, provides additional evidence to support the conclusion?
qs.zh: 以下哪项（如果为真）为支持这一结论提供了更多证据？

opts.t: Viruses are much more difficult to identify in postmortem analysis than bacteria are.
opts.cn: 病毒比细菌更难在死后分析中识别。

opts.t: Mediterranean monk seals are the only species of seal in the area where the bacterium was found.
opts.cn: 地中海m海豹是发现细菌的海域中唯一的海豹物种。

opts.t: The bacterium is almost always present in the water in at least small concentrations.
opts.cn: 这种细菌几乎总是以至少少量的浓度存在于水中。

opts.t: Nearly all the recent deaths were among adult seals, but young seals are far more susceptible to viruses than are adult seals.
opts.cn: 最近死亡的几乎都是成年海豹，但小海豹比成年海豹更容易感染病毒。

opts.t: Several years ago, a large number of monk seals died in the same area as a result of exposure to a different bacterial toxin.
opts.cn: 几年前，同一地区也有大量m海豹因接触到另一种细菌毒素而死亡。

qs.label: D
qs.why:
背景信息：大量m海豹最近死亡。
证据：死后分析表明，海豹体内存在一种尚未查明的病毒以及一种已知的细菌毒素。海豹死亡海域的海水样本中含有异常高浓度的有毒细菌。
结论：这些死亡更可能是细菌毒素造成的。

D选项指出了近期死亡的几乎都是成年海豹，而幼年海豹比成年海豹更容易受到病毒的影响。这意味着如果死亡主要发生在成年海豹中，那么与病毒相关的死亡可能性较低，从而进一步支持结论是细菌毒素而非病毒导致的死亡。
其他选项并不直接支持细菌毒素比病毒更有可能导致死亡的结论。

html: In the shallow end of Lake Tomwa, there are remains of numerous Jeffery pine trees that grew there during a lengthy drought. Researchers had believed that this drought lasted at least 150 years, but carbon dating reveals that pines were growing in the lake bed for only 120 years, from 1200 until 1320. Since the Jeffrey pines, which cannot survive in water, must have died at the end of the drought, the dating shows that the drought lasted less than 150 years.
zh:
①在T湖的浅水区，有许多J松树的残骸，它们是在长期干旱期间生长在这里的。
②研究人员曾认为这场干旱至少持续了 150 年，但碳年代测定显示，松树在湖床中生长的时间只有 120 年，即从 1200 年到 1320 年。
③由于J松不能在水中存活，肯定是在干旱结束时死亡的，因此年代测定显示干旱持续了不到 150 年。

qs.stem: The argument given relies on which of the following as an assumption?
qs.zh: 该论证依赖于以下哪项假设？

opts.t: No other species of tree started growing in the bed of Lake Tomwa after 1200.
opts.cn: 1200 年之后，T湖的湖床上没有其他树种开始生长。

opts.t: No tree remains of any kind are present at the bottom of deeper parts of Lake Tomwa.
opts.cn: T湖较深的湖底没有任何树木遗迹。

opts.t: There was at least one tree in the lake bed that was alive for the entire period from 1200 to 1320.
opts.cn: 从 1200 年到 1320 年的整个期间，湖床中至少有一棵树是活着的。

opts.t: There has not been a more recent drought that caused a drying up of the shallow end of the lake.
opts.cn: 最近的干旱并没有导致湖的浅水区干涸。

opts.t: The shallow end of the lake had been dry for less than 30 years by the time Jeffrey pines started growing in the lake bed.
opts.cn: 当J松开始在湖床生长时，湖的浅水区干涸了不到 30 年。

qs.label: E
qs.why:
背景：在T湖的浅水区，有许多J松树的残骸，它们是在长期干旱期间生长在这里的。
证据：碳年代测定显示，松树在湖床中生长的时间只有 120 年。J松不能在水中存活，肯定是在干旱结束时死亡的。
结论：干旱持续了不到 150 年。

E是关键假设，如果湖床在松树开始生长之前已经干燥了很长时间，那么松树生长的时间就不能准确反映整个干旱期的长度。例如，如果在J松树开始生长时干旱已经持续了超过30年，那么再加上J松树生长期的120年，总干旱期就会超过150年。

html: New methods developed in genetic research have led taxonomists to revise their views on the evolutionary relationships between many species. Traditionally the relatedness of species has been ascertained by a close comparison of their anatomy. The new methods infer the  closeness of any two species’ relationship to each other directly from similarities between the species’ genetic codes.
zh:
①基因研究中开发的新方法促使分类学家重新审视许多物种之间的进化关系。
②传统上，物种之间的亲缘关系是通过近距离比较其解剖结构来确定的。
③新方法直接从物种遗传密码的相似性来推断任何两个物种之间的亲缘关系。

qs.stem: Which of the following conclusions is best supported by the information?
qs.zh: 这些信息最能支持以下哪个结论？

opts.t: The apparent degree of relatedness of some species,  as determined by anatomical criteria, is not borne out by their degree of genetic similarity.
opts.cn: 根据解剖学标准确定的某些物种的表面亲缘程度并不能从它们的遗传相似程度中得到证实。

opts.t: When they know the differences between two species’ genetic codes, taxonomists can infer what the observable anatomical differences between those species must be.
opts.cn: 当分类学家知道两个物种遗传密码的差异时，他们就能推断出这些物种之间可观察到的解剖学差异。

opts.t: The degree to which individuals of the same species are anatomically similar is determined more by their genetic codes than by such environmental factors as food supply.
opts.cn: 同一物种的个体在解剖学上的相似程度更多地取决于它们的遗传密码，而不是食物供应等环境因素。

opts.t: The traditional anatomical methods by which taxonomists investigated the relatedness of species are incapable of any further refinement.
opts.cn: 分类学家研究物种亲缘关系的传统解剖学方法已无法进一步完善。

opts.t: Without the use of genetic methods, taxonomists would never be able to obtain any accurate information about species’ degrees of relatedness to one another.
opts.cn: 如果不使用基因方法，分类学家将永远无法获得关于物种之间亲缘程度的任何准确信息。

qs.label: A
qs.why:
根据文段给出的已知信息推理出一个结论，需要注意不能脑补。
原文的给出的已知信息：
一，确定物种之间的亲缘关系的传统方法是比较解剖结构。
二，确定物种之间的亲缘关系的新方法是看物种遗传密码的相似性。
三，新方法促使分类学家重新审视许多物种之间的进化关系。

新方法使分类学家重新审视许多物种之间的进化关系，说明新方法得出结论和传统方法是不一致的，对应A选项。

html: Greene ’ s sparrows build their nests in marsh grasses above the usual summer water levels. Over the last three years, the Greene ’ s sparrow population in Stillwater Marsh declined precipitously because heavy summer rains raised water levels and flooded nests before the young sparrows matured. The Greene ’ s sparrow population also declined in a neighboring marsh, even though its higher elevation kept that marsh from being flooded. Nevertheless, this decline is also attributable to the heavy rains, because _______.
zh:
①G麻雀在夏季通常水位以上的沼泽草丛中筑巢。
②在过去的三年里，SM的G麻雀数量急剧下降，因为夏季暴雨导致水位升高，在小麻雀成熟之前就淹没了巢穴。
③邻近沼泽中的G麻雀数量也在下降，尽管该沼泽海拔较高，没有被洪水淹没。
④尽管如此，这一下降也可归因于暴雨，因为 _______。

qs.stem: Which of the following most logically completes the argument?
qs.zh: 以下哪项最符合逻辑？

opts.t: the populations of birds that build their nests in trees near either marsh did not decline over the last three years
opts.cn: 在这两个沼泽附近的树上筑巢的鸟类数量在过去三年中没有减少

opts.t: when Greene's sparrows lose their offspring in floods, the sparrows usually nest in different areas the next summer
opts.h: when Greene's sparrows lose their offspring in floods, the sparrows usually nest in different areas the next summer
opts.cn: 当G麻雀在洪水中失去后代时，麻雀通常会在第二年夏天到不同的地方筑巢

opts.t: much of the food that Greene's sparrows feed their offspring is brought into marshes by seasonal floods
opts.h: much of the food that Greene's sparrows feed their offspring is brought into marshes by seasonal floods
opts.cn: G雀哺育后代的大部分食物是由季节性洪水带入沼泽的

opts.t: the snakes that normally prey on the Greene's sparrows in Stillwater Marsh were forced to look elsewhere for prey after the flooding
opts.h: the snakes that normally prey on the Greene's sparrows in Stillwater Marsh were forced to look elsewhere for prey after the flooding
opts.cn: 洪水过后，通常在SM捕食G麻雀的蛇被迫到其他地方寻找猎物

opts.t: water levels never fall quickly in either Stillwater Marsh or the nearby marsh
opts.cn: 无论是SM还是附近的沼泽，水位都不会迅速下降

qs.label: D
qs.why:
背景信息：G麻雀在夏季通常水位以上的沼泽草丛中筑巢。在过去的三年里，SM的G麻雀数量急剧下降，因为夏季暴雨导致水位升高，在小麻雀成熟之前就淹没了巢穴。邻近沼泽中的G麻雀数量也在下降。
证据：待补充。
结论：尽管邻近沼泽海拔较高，没有被洪水淹没，但该沼泽G麻雀数量下降也可归因于暴雨。

需要找一个证据去支撑结论：虽然邻近沼泽没有被洪水淹没，但该沼泽G麻雀数量下降也可归因于暴雨。
D选项说洪水过后，通常在SM捕食G麻雀的蛇被迫到其他地方寻找猎物。说明暴雨导致了原本在SM捕食G麻雀的蛇到其他地方寻找食物，从而导致临近沼泽G麻雀数量下降。说明了虽然邻近沼泽没有被洪水淹没，但G麻雀数量下降归根到底还是暴雨导致的。

html: Benovians set their clocks back an hour for the winter. The result is that, during winter’s short days, it is light when most commuters drive to work, but dark when they drive back home. Darkness contributes to accidents. Changing the clocks, however, does not actually increase the amount of driving done in the dark, so it is unlikely to have any effect on Benovia’s automobile accident rate.
zh:
①B人在冬季将时钟调后一小时。
②结果就是，在冬季短暂的白天里，大多数上班族开车去上班时天是亮的，而开车回家时天却是黑的。
③黑暗会导致交通事故。
④然而，改变时钟实际上并不会增加在黑暗中开车的人数，因此不太可能对 B 的汽车事故率产生任何影响。

qs.stem: Which of the following is an assumption on which the argument relies?
qs.zh: 以下哪项是论证所依据的假设？

opts.t: The average number of hours that Benovians drive when it is dark is greater for days during the winter than for days during other times of the year.
opts.cn: B 人在冬季天黑时驾车的平均时长比一年中其他时间的天数要多。

opts.t: In Benovia, hazards to safe driving that are made worse by darkness are as likely to occur in the morning as in the evening.
opts.cn: 在 B，因黑暗而加剧的安全驾驶危险在早晨和傍晚同样可能发生。

opts.t: The majority of cars on Benovia’s roads during a given day are those of people commuting to or from work.
opts.cn: 每天在 B 道路上行驶的大多数车辆都是上下班的车辆。

opts.t: The majority of automobile accidents in Benovia take place when it is dark.
opts.cn: 在 B，大多数车祸都发生在天黑的时候。

opts.t: Driving conditions are no worse in Benovia in the winter than during the rest of the year.
opts.cn: B 冬季的驾驶条件并不比其他季节差。

qs.label: B
qs.why:
背景：B人在冬季将时钟调后一小时。结果就是，在冬季，大多数上班族开车去上班时天是亮的，而开车回家时天是黑的。黑暗会导致交通事故。
证据：改变时钟实际上并不会增加在黑暗中开车的人数。
结论：改变时钟不太可能对 B 的汽车事故率产生任何影响。

原论证认为，虽然冬天调整时钟改变了白天和黑暗的驾驶时间分布（冬天上班亮，下班黑；如果不调钟上班黑，下班亮），但因为“开车时的黑暗总时间并未增加”，所以这种调整对事故率不会有影响。
要使这个结论成立，必须假设黑暗对安全驾驶的影响在早晚是一样的，否则，早晨和晚上的黑暗驾驶时间重新分配可能仍会导致事故率变化。
如果早晨的黑暗更危险，重新分配黑暗驾驶时间就可能影响事故率，即便开车时的黑暗总时间是不变的（只是从早上黑暗中开车，变成晚上黑暗中开车）。所以，B是论证成立必要的假设。

html: Bats hunt for their prey, including moths, by emitting ultrasonic squeaks and analyzing the echoes. Arctiid moths are unusual in that they emit distinctive ultrasonic noises of their own in response to the hunting squeaks of bats, thereby giving away their location to the bats. These facts support the hypothesis that the moths protect themselves somehow by revealing their whereabouts to the bats.
zh:
①蝙蝠通过发出超声波尖叫并分析回声来捕食包括飞蛾在内的猎物。
②A蛾的与众不同之处在于，它们会发出自己独特的超声波来回应蝙蝠的捕食尖叫声，从而向蝙蝠暴露自己的位置。
③这些事实支持这样的假设，即飞蛾通过向蝙蝠透露自己的行踪来保护自己。

qs.stem: Which of the following, if true, provides the strongest additional support for the hypothesis given?
qs.zh: 以下哪项如果为真，能为假设提供最有力的补充支持？

opts.t: Arctiid moths produce their ultrasonic noises with a special membrane that is permanently silenced if it is physically damaged.
opts.cn: A蛾用一种特殊的膜发出超声波，如果这种膜受到物理损坏，就会永久失声。

opts.t: Arctiid moths react to artificial bat squeaks in much the same way that they react to squeaks actually emitted by bats.
opts.cn: A蛾对人工蝙蝠叫声的反应与它们对蝙蝠发出的叫声的反应基本相同。

opts.t: Arctiid moths are more colorful and more strikingly patterned than are many other kinds of moth.
opts.cn: 与许多其他种类的蛾子相比，A蛾的颜色更鲜艳，花纹更醒目。

opts.t: Arctiid moths, like all other moths, are promptly killed if they get caught by hunting bats.
opts.cn: A蛾和其他蛾子一样，一旦被捕食的蝙蝠抓住，就会立即被杀死。

opts.t: Arctiid moths taste very unpleasant to bats but are the same general shape and size as moths that bats like to eat.
opts.cn: A蛾的味道对蝙蝠来说非常难吃，但其形状和大小与蝙蝠喜欢吃的蛾子大致相同。

qs.label: E
qs.why:
证据：蝙蝠通过发出超声波来猎捕包括蛾子在内的猎物。斑蛾（Arctiid moths）很特别，它们会对蝙蝠的超声波发出自己独特的超声波响应，暴露自己的位置。
结论：这些事实支持这样的假设：A蛾通过向蝙蝠暴露自己的位置来保护自己。

我们需要找到一个选项，进一步支持假设，即A蛾通过向蝙蝠暴露自己的位置来保护自己。

E选项补充的信息是 A蛾味道不好，蝙蝠不喜欢吃它们。但因为它们看起来和其他美味的蛾子差不多，所以蝙蝠可能会误吃。如果A蛾主动告诉蝙蝠“嘿，我在这儿，我是不好吃的A蛾哦！”，蝙蝠就会避开它们。这就解释了 A蛾如何通过暴露位置来保护自己。

其他选项：
Arctiid moths produce their ultrasonic noises with a special membrane that is permanently silenced if it is physically damaged.
这个选项告诉我们 A蛾如何发声，但并没有解释它们如何通过暴露位置来保护自己。虽然知道它们的“声带”很脆弱，但这对支持假设没有直接帮助。
Arctiid moths react to artificial bat squeaks in much the same way that they react to squeaks actually emitted by bats.
这个选项说明了 A蛾的反应机制，但仍未解释它们如何通过暴露位置来保护自己。知道它们对假的蝙蝠叫声也有反应，但这并不能加强假设。
Arctiid moths, like all other moths, are promptly killed if they get caught by hunting bats.
颜色和花纹并不能解释它们如何通过发声来保护自己。
Arctiid moths, like all other moths, are promptly killed if they get caught by hunting bats.
A蛾被蝙蝠抓到就没命了，但这似乎在说 A蛾更应该躲起来，而不是暴露自己。所以，这不支持假设，反而可能削弱它。

html: Monarch butterflies lay their eggs hundreds of miles away from their places of origin. Each caterpillar that emerges feeds exclusively on milkweed, absorbing the glycosides that milkweed contains. Butterflies contain the glycosides they absorb as caterpillars. Research on monarch butterflies whose migration has been tracked shows that the combination of glycosides in a butterfly always exactly matches the distinctive combination of glycosides that exists in the species of milkweed in the butterfly's place of origin.
zh:
①M蝴蝶在离其原产地数百英里的地方产卵。
②每只幼虫孵化后都会专门以m为食，吸收m含有的G。
③蝴蝶体内含有其幼虫期吸收的G。
④对追踪过迁徙的M蝴蝶进行的研究显示，蝴蝶体内的G组合总是与其出生地的m物种中存在的独特G组合完全匹配。

qs.stem: If the information provided is true, which of the following is most strongly supported on the basis of it?
qs.zh: 根据提供的信息，最有力支持以下哪一项？

opts.t: The glycosides present in a monarch caterpillar will generally match those that were present in the butterfly that laid the egg from which the caterpillar emerged.
opts.cn: M蝶幼虫体内的G通常会与产下它的卵的那只蝴蝶体内的G相匹配。

opts.t: Glycosides play an essential role in the biological mechanism that guides a monarch butterfly in its migration.
opts.cn: G在指导M蝴蝶迁徙的生物机制中起着至关重要的作用。

opts.t: The monarch butterflies present in a given region will all contain the same specific combination of glycosides
opts.cn: 一个特定地区的M蝴蝶都含有相同的G组合。

opts.t: A monarch butterfly does not absorb and accumulate glycosides from the milkweed of regions it reaches as a result of migration.
opts.cn: M蝴蝶不会从迁徙到的地区的含有G的m吸收和积累G。

opts.t: Glycosides are the only identifiable substances from milkweed that accumulate in a monarch caterpillar and are retained in the body of the butterfly after metamorphosis
opts.cn: G是m中可识别的唯一在M蝴蝶的幼虫中积累并在蝴蝶变态后保留在体内的物质。

qs.label: D
qs.why:
迁徙过的蝴蝶体内的G组合总是与它出生地m物种中存在的独特G组合完全匹配，即蝴蝶体内保留的都是其幼虫期吸收的G。推出它成长之后，迁徙到了其他地方之后，不会继续在体内吸收和积累当地的G。

其他选项：
The glycosides present in a monarch caterpillar will generally match those that were present in the butterfly that laid the egg from which the caterpillar emerged.
原文没有说蝴蝶会把配糖体传递给卵或下一代。幼虫吸收的是乳草中的配糖体，而不是继承母亲的配糖体。

Glycosides play an essential role in the biological mechanism that guides a monarch butterfly in its migration.
迁徙的机制原文完全没有讨论，不能凭借配糖体的存在推断它有“引导迁徙”的功能。

The monarch butterflies present in a given region will all contain the same specific combination of glycosides.
“present in a region” ≠ “出生在这个区域”。有些蝴蝶是迁徙来的，体内的配糖体仍然是它出生地的。所以在同一个区域的蝴蝶，配糖体组合可以不同。

Glycosides are the only identifiable substances from milkweed that accumulate in a monarch caterpillar and are retained in the body of the butterfly after metamorphosis.
“only identifiable substances”太绝对，原文没说过“配糖体是唯一被保留的乳草成分”。

html: Bonobos, a kind of ape, spend the night in large groups, each night in a new location within their territory. By day, they travel along forest trails in separate small foraging parties. The lead part occasionally stamps down plants along the trail that it takes. Researchers hypothesize that the flattened plants, by serving as markers for parties that follow, are what enables the whole group to reunite at dusk, since ______ .
zh:
①倭黑猩猩是一种类人猿，它们成群结队地过夜，每晚都在自己领地内的一个新地点过夜。
②白天，它们会在森林小径上进行单独的小型觅食活动。
③先导团队会沿着它们所走的小路踩下植物。
④研究人员猜想，被踩倒的植物作为随后汇合的标记，是使得整个群体能在黄昏时汇合的原因，因为______。

qs.stem: Which of the following most logically completes the passage?
qs.zh: 以下哪一项最合乎逻辑地完成了这篇文章？

opts.t: the small foraging parties are more exposed to predators than the large groups are
opts.cn: 小型觅食群体比大型群体更容易受到捕食者的攻击

opts.t: bonobos from different foraging parties engage in a wide range of social interactions with each other when reunited in the group
opts.cn: 来自不同觅食群体的倭黑猩猩在群体中汇合时，会进行广泛的社交互动

opts.t: occasionally a foraging party breaks up into yet smaller parties
opts.cn: 偶尔，觅食派对会分成更小的派对

opts.t: the number and composition of the parties varies from day to day
opts.cn: 各方的人数和组成每天都不尽相同

opts.t: although the bonobos are very vocal when in large groups, they are generally silent otherwise
opts.h: although the bonobos are very vocal when in large groups, they are generally silent otherwise
opts.cn: 尽管倭黑猩猩成大群时声音很大，但在其他情况下它们通常是安静的

qs.label: E
qs.why:
背景信息：B会分成小分队觅食，但是会汇合在一起过夜。每晚过夜的地点都不同。
证据：_____，（空格待填）
结论：B群体用被踩倒的植物作为黄昏汇合的标记，来找到汇合的地点。

倭黑猩猩（bonobos）在夜晚以大群体聚集，而白天则分成小组觅食。研究者假设，带路的小组踩踏的植物为其他小组提供了路径标记，从而使整个群体能在傍晚重新汇合。假设的逻辑基础在于：这些路径标记对群体重新聚集是必要的。
空格需要补充一个信息来支持研究者的假设。

E说猩猩通常都很安静，说明它们不是靠发出声音来互相交流，找到汇合点。这个信息通过排除了一个另外的可能性（它们并不会用声音来互相召唤），强调除了踩踏的路径，其他信号（如声音）无法起到作用，从而凸显了路径标记的重要性。

其他选项：
the small foraging parties are more exposed to predators than the large groups are
小组觅食时的安全性和如何通过踩踏植物标记帮助群体汇合无关。

bonobos from different foraging parties engage in a wide range of social interactions with each other when reunited in the group
汇合后的互动无法解释为什么踩踏植物标记是群体汇合的必要条件。

occasionally a foraging party breaks up into yet smaller parties
小组可能进一步分解的情况没有直接支持踩踏植物标记在重新汇合过程中的作用。

the number and composition of the parties varies from day to day
小组规模和组成的变化，不能解释踩踏植物标记为何对群体汇合至关重要。

html: Antilock braking systems decrease the chance that a car will skid out of control when its driver is trying to make a sudden stop. Since collisions often occur when cars skid out of control, antilock braking systems will decrease the likelihood of collision for a driver attempting a sudden stop in a risky driving situation.
zh:
①防抱死制动系统可降低汽车在驾驶员试图急刹车时失控打滑的几率。
②由于汽车失控打滑时往往会发生碰撞，因此防抱死制动系统可降低驾驶员在危险驾驶情况下试图急刹车时发生碰撞的可能性。

qs.stem: Which of the following, if true, would most strengthen the argument?
qs.zh: 如果以下哪项为真，最能加强这一论证？

opts.t: Most of the situations in which cars skid out of control do not result in collisions.
opts.cn: 汽车失控打滑的大多数情况不会导致碰撞。

opts.t: A highly skilled driver can keep a car without an antilock braking system from skidding out of control during even the most sudden stop.
opts.cn: 一个技术娴熟的驾驶员可以使一辆没有防抱死制动系统的汽车在最急刹车时也不会失控侧滑。

opts.t: People who buy cars with such safety features as antilock braking systems tend to be careful drivers who avoid risky driving situations.
opts.cn: 购买具有防抱死制动系统等安全功能汽车的人往往是谨慎的驾驶者，他们会避免危险的驾驶情况。

opts.t: In the course of a year, the average driver will be in no more than ten risky driving situations in which a sudden stop is required to avoid a collision.
opts.cn: 在一年的时间里，一般驾驶员遇到的需要急刹车以避免碰撞的危险驾驶情况不会超过十次。

opts.t: Drivers of taxis without antilock braking systems tend to avoid risky driving situations more than do drivers of taxis with antilocking systems, yet their collision rate is the same.
opts.cn: 与装有防抱死制动系统的出租车相比，没有防抱死制动系统的出租车司机更倾向于避免危险驾驶情况，但他们的碰撞率是相同的。

qs.label: E
qs.why:
证据1：防抱死刹车系统（antilock braking systems, ABS）可以降低汽车在司机突然刹车时失控打滑的概率。
证据2：碰撞事故经常发生在汽车失控打滑的时候。
结论：所以，在有风险的驾驶情境中，如果司机需要突然刹车，ABS 会降低发生碰撞的可能性。

逻辑链条是：ABS 减少失控打滑 + 失控打滑常导致碰撞 → 所以 ABS 减少碰撞

E 选项说，没有 ABS 的出租车司机，比有 ABS 的出租车司机更倾向于避开危险驾驶情境；但是两者的碰撞率却一样。
如果没有 ABS 的司机更谨慎、更少进入危险情境，按理说他们的碰撞率应该更低。
但结果却是：他们的碰撞率和有 ABS 的司机一样。

这就暗示，有 ABS 的车即使面对更多风险，碰撞率仍没有更高，说明 ABS 很可能确实在降低碰撞风险。即，ABS 抵消了更多危险情境带来的风险。

其他选项：
Most of the situations in which cars skid out of control do not result in collisions.
原文依赖的是“减少打滑能减少碰撞”。如果大多数打滑根本不导致碰撞，那么 ABS 减少打滑未必能明显减少碰撞。

A highly skilled driver can keep a car without an antilock braking system from skidding out of control during even the most sudden stop.
这反而说明至少对技术很好的司机来说，没有 ABS 也可以避免打滑。它削弱了“ABS 能降低碰撞”的普遍性。

People who buy cars with such safety features as antilock braking systems tend to be careful drivers who avoid risky driving situations.
如果有 ABS 的车碰撞率低，可能只是因为车主本来就更谨慎，而不是 ABS 本身有效。它会引入一个替代解释：低事故率来自司机谨慎，不来自 ABS。

In the course of a year, the average driver will be in no more than ten risky driving situations in which a sudden stop is required to avoid a collision.
这只是说明这种情境发生频率不高。它没有说明 ABS 在这种情境下是否能降低碰撞概率。频率多少不等于系统是否有效。

html: The Menkentown Business Herald dated June 4,1965 , carried an article about four dry cleaners in Menkentown and reported that in 1964 each of them took in a larger proportion of the total dollar amount spent by Menkentown residents at dry cleaners than it had in 1963. Assuming that the article is accurate and that during 1963 and 1964 no Menkentown resident patronized any dry cleaner outside of Menkentown, it follows that _____.
zh:
①1965 年 6 月 4 日的MBH刊登了一篇关于M镇四家干洗店的文章，报道称 1964 年M镇居民在干洗店的消费总额中，每家干洗店所占比例都高于 1963 年。
②假设这篇文章是准确的，并且在 1963 年和 1964 年期间，没有M镇居民光顾M镇以外的任何干洗店，那么 _____。

qs.stem: Which of the following most logically completes the argument given?
qs.zh: 以下哪项最符合逻辑地完成了所给的论证？

opts.t: the average cost of having an article of clothing dry-cleaned was higher in 1964 than in 1963
opts.cn: 1964 年干洗一件衣服的平均成本高于 1963 年

opts.t: total revenues received by Menkentown's dry cleaners increased between 1963 and 1964
opts.h: total revenues received by Menkentown's dry cleaners increased between 1963 and 1964
opts.cn: 1963 年至 1964 年，M镇干洗店的总收入增加了

opts.t: there were more than four dry cleaners in Menkentown in 1963
opts.cn: 1963 年，M有四家以上的干洗店

opts.t: the total number of dry cleaners in Menkentown increased during 1963
opts.cn: 1963 年，M镇的干洗店总数有所增加

opts.t: some dry cleaners in Menkentown that were in operation in 1963 were not in operation in 1964
opts.cn: 1963 年在M镇营业的一些干洗店在 1964 年没有营业

qs.label: C

html: Seeds of wild plants generally have thick coats that allow them to survive in the ground until the next growing season. But with domesticated plants, seeds are not sown until the growing season begins. Accordingly, within a given domesticated species, plants with thinner-coated seeds, which germinate more quickly, are advantaged, since quicker germination enables a plant to shade out its slower neighbors, thereby increasing its livelihood of surviving to harvest and contributing seeds to the next planting
zh:
①野生植物的种子一般都有厚厚的外壳，可以在地下存活到下一个生长季节。
②但对于家养植物来说，种子要到生长季节开始时才播种。
③因此，在特定的家养物种中，种子外皮较薄、发芽较快的植物处于优势地位，因为较快的发芽速度能使植物遮挡住较慢的邻居，从而提高其生存能力，使其能够收获并为下一次种植提供种子。

qs.stem: The information given if accurate, provides the strongest justification for which of the following claims?
qs.zh: 所提供的信息如果准确的话，能为以下哪种说法提供最有力的支持？

opts.t: In the wild, a plant gains no reproductive advantage if its seeds germinate before the seeds of other plants.
opts.cn: 在野外，如果一种植物的种子比其他植物的种子先发芽，那么它就不会获得繁殖优势。

opts.t: The relative thickness of the coats of the seeds of two species of domesticated plants reliably indicates which of the plants will grow more quickly.
opts.cn: 两种家养植物种子外皮的相对厚度能可靠地表明哪种植物生长得更快。

opts.t: A wild plant such as the Chiltepin, whose seeds have extremely thick coats that ensure that they survive the digestive systems of animals, will be at a disadvantage compared to a wild plant whose seed coats protect only against cold.
opts.h: A wild plant such as the Chiltepin, whose seeds have extremely thick coats that ensure that they survive the digestive systems of animals, will be at a disadvantage compared to a wild plant whose seed coats protect only against cold.
opts.cn: 与种皮仅能抵御寒冷的野生植物相比，野生植物（如C）的种子具有极厚的种皮，可以确保它们在动物的消化系统中存活下来。

opts.t: The cache of Chenopodium seeds found at a 3,500-year-old cave dwelling whose coats are significantly thinner than those of Chenopodium known to have grown wild then, supports the hypothesis that the plant had been domesticated by that time.
opts.cn: 在一处距今 3500 年的洞穴中发现的C植物种子的种皮比当时已知的野生C植物种子的种皮薄得多，这支持了该植物在当时已经被家养的假设。

opts.t: That one of two seeds of the same domesticated species has a thicker coat than the other is evidence that the seed with the thicker coat came from a plant grown in the colder climate.
opts.cn: 同一驯化物种的两粒种子中，一粒种子的外皮比另一粒厚，这证明外皮较厚的种子来自在寒冷气候中生长的植物。

qs.label: D
qs.why:
文章讨论了野生植物的种子通常具有较厚的外壳以便在土壤中存活到下一个生长季节，而家养植物的种子外壳更薄，这有利于它们更快地发芽。根据这个信息，家养植物的种子发芽速度更快，有利于植物生长并存活到收获期，这为选项D提供了有力的证据支持。
选项D提出的情况是，一个3500年前的洞穴住所中发现的C植物的种子外壳明显比当时已知的野生种类薄，这与文章提到的信息一致，即家养植物的种子外壳更薄，有利于它们更快地发芽和生长。

其他选项：
In the wild, a plant gains no reproductive advantage if its seeds germinate before the seeds of other plants.
这个说法与原文相悖。在野生环境中，种子的早发芽可以是一个优势，尤其是在资源竞争激烈的环境中，原文并未涉及野生植物种子发芽时间的优势问题。
The relative thickness of the coats of the seeds of two species of domesticated plants reliably indicates which of the plants will grow more quickly.
原文中只提到了种子外壳厚度影响发芽速度，并未说它决定了整个生长周期的速度。
A wild plant such as the Chiltepin, whose seeds have extremely thick coats that ensure that they survive the digestive systems of animals, will be at a disadvantage compared to a wild plant whose seed coats protect only against cold.
此选项涉及种子外壳的适应性功能（保护种子免受消化系统破坏与抵御寒冷），这与原文的讨论焦点不同，原文主要讨论的是驯化植物种子与野生种子之间的差异。
That one of two seeds of the same domesticated species has a thicker coat than the other is evidence that the seed with the thicker coat came from a plant grown in the colder climate.
原文中并未提及种子外壳厚度与气候条件的直接关联。

html: Cuts that need to be held closed in order to heal properly have generally been held closed with stitches. However, pressure to reduce medical costs is mounting. Consequently, it is likely that a newly developed adhesive will become the routine method of holding most types of cuts closed. The new adhesive holds most types of cuts closed as well as stitches do, and the cost of applying it is comparable to that of closing cuts with stitches. But whereas stitches must generally be removed by medical personnel after the cut has healed, the adhesive simply wears off. Thus, for any cut that the adhesive can hold closed as well as stitches can, it is more economical to use the adhesive.
zh:
①需要缝合才能正常愈合的伤口一般都要缝合。
②然而，降低医疗成本的压力越来越大。
③因此，一种新开发的粘合剂很可能成为固定大多数类型伤口的常规方法。
④这种新型粘合剂可以像缝合针线一样粘合大多数类型的伤口，而且粘合剂的成本与缝合伤口的成本相当。
⑤不过，缝线一般必须在伤口愈合后由医护人员拆除，而粘合剂只需磨掉即可。
⑥因此，对于粘合剂能像缝针一样缝合的伤口，使用粘合剂更为经济。

qs.stem: In the argument given, the two highlighted portions play which of the following roles?
qs.zh: 在所给的论证中，两个加粗部分起着以下哪种作用？

opts.t: The first is a claim that the argument disputes; the second provides evidence against that disputed claim.
opts.cn: 第一个加粗是论据提出异议的主张；第二个加粗提供了反对该有争议主张的证据。

opts.t: The first is a claim that is used as supporting evidence for the main conclusion of the argument; the second is that main conclusion.
opts.cn: 第一个加粗是作为论证主要结论的辅助证据的主张；第二个加粗是该主要结论。

opts.t: The first is a claim that is used as supporting evidence for the main conclusion of the argument; the second is a conclusion that is drawn in order to support that main conclusion.
opts.cn: 第一个加粗是作为论证主要结论支持证据的主张；第二个加粗是为了支持该主要结论而得出的结论。

opts.t: The first introduces a practice about which the argument makes  a prediction,  the second is a conclusion based on that prediction.
opts.cn: 第一个加粗介绍了一种实践，论证对这种实践做出了预测；第二个加粗是基于这种预测得出的结论。

opts.t: The first introduces a practice about which the argument makes a prediction; the second is an assessment that is used to support that prediction.
opts.cn: 第一个加粗介绍了一种实践，论证对这种实践做出了预测；第二个加粗是用来支持这种预测的评估。

qs.label: E
qs.why:
背景信息：介绍了一种实践，即通常使用缝合线来闭合需要闭合的伤口以促进其正确愈合。降低医疗成本的压力越来越大。
证据：粘合剂能像缝合线一样有效地闭合伤口的情况下，它具有成本优势（不需要医护人员移除）。
中间结论：新的粘合剂更为经济。
主结论：预测新型粘合剂将成为闭合大多数类型伤口的常规方法。

作者的论证逻辑是，因为粘合剂是有效的，且不需要医护人员移除，所以新的粘合剂更为经济。因为新的粘合剂更为经济，所以预测新型粘合剂将成为常规方法。
作者的叙述顺序是，先交代背景信息（前两句话），然后丢出主结论（第三句的预测），然后给出一个论证来支持主结论。
所以，第一个加粗介绍了一种实践（通常使用缝合线），论证对这种实践做出了预测（会被新型粘合剂替代）；第二个加粗是基于第四句和第五句描述的医护成本得出的结论，用来支持第三句提出的预测。选E选项。

html: The elimination of wolves from Vernon National Park fifty years ago coincided with the beginning of a decline in the park’s aspen groves. Since wolves hunt elk and elk feed on young aspen trees in winter, it might seem that the wolves elimination played a part in the decline of the aspen groves. There is, however, no such causal connection: a wildlife-management program prevented an increase in the park’s elk population by regularly relocating elk to other parks.
zh:
①五十年前，V国家公园消灭狼群的同时，公园里的杨树林也开始衰退。
②由于狼会捕食麋鹿，而麋鹿在冬季又以杨树幼苗为食，因此狼被消灭似乎与杨树林的衰退有一定的关系。
③然而，这两者之间并没有因果关系：野生动物管理计划通过定期将麋鹿迁移到其他公园，防止了公园麋鹿数量的增加。

qs.stem: Which of the following, if true, most seriously weakens the argument?
qs.zh: 如果以下哪项为真，最能削弱这一论证？

opts.t: Mature male elk are readily able to withstand an attack by wolves.
opts.cn: 成熟的雄性麋鹿很容易抵御狼群的攻击。

opts.t: Industrial pollution has brought about a change in the chemical composition of rain that falls on the park thus causing harm to many tree species. including aspen.
opts.cn: 工业污染导致落在公园里的雨水的化学成分发生变化，从而对包括杨树在内的许多树种造成危害。

opts.t: It was because of the elimination of wolves from the park that the wildlife-management program to control the elk population was introduced.
opts.cn: 正是因为公园里的狼被消灭了，才有了控制麋鹿数量的野生动物管理计划。

opts.t: In the summer. a wide range of vegetation other than aspen is available for elk to eat.
opts.cn: 夏季，麋鹿可以吃到杨树以外的多种植被。

opts.t: When wolves are nearby, elk avoid aspen groves for fear of getting trapped.
opts.cn: 当狼出现在附近时，麋鹿会因为害怕被困而避开杨树林。

qs.label: E
qs.why:
背景：五十年前，V国家公园消灭狼群的同时，公园里的杨树林也开始衰退。
被攻击的论证：因为（证据）狼会捕食麋鹿，而麋鹿在冬季又以杨树幼苗为食，所以（结论）狼被消灭似乎与杨树林的衰退有一定的关系。

证据：一项野生动物管理计划通过定期将麋鹿迁移到其他公园，阻止了公园麋鹿数量的增加。（狼的消失 ≠ 麋鹿数量增加）
结论：狼的消失与白杨树林的减少之间没有因果关系

E 选项指出狼的存在改变麋鹿行为/空间利用：有狼→麋鹿回避杨树林；无狼→麋鹿更敢进入杨树林。
即使“prevented an increase”保证数量稳定，行为变化仍会提高对幼杨的啃食压力，从而使“no such causal connection”不成立。→ 最强削弱。

其他选项：
Mature male elk are readily able to withstand an attack by wolves.
只谈成年雄性的抗狼能力，既不推翻“prevented an increase”，也不表明狼的消失会增加对杨树林的取食压力。

Industrial pollution has brought about a change in the chemical composition of rain that falls on the park thus causing harm to many tree species. including aspen.
加强结论。给出替代原因解释杨树衰退，配合“There is, however, no such causal connection”的立场：不是狼导致的。这不是削弱，而是支持“无因果”。

It was because of the elimination of wolves from the park that the wildlife-management program to control the elk population was introduced.
这只解释项目为何启动，但并没否认题干的关键事实：项目确实“prevented an increase”。既不显示麋鹿数量上升，也没有揭示行为路径导致取食压力上升。
动机/缘起 ≠ 结果/成效。题干的反因果论证是建立在项目成效之上的，C 不触及成效。

In the summer. a wide range of vegetation other than aspen is available for elk to eat.
题干点明取食发生在冬季（引文：“…elk feed on young aspen trees in winter”）。夏季食谱不影响冬季对幼杨的啃食压力。

html: A chemical present in all grapes helps reduce blood cholesterol in humans. The chemical is also present in red wine and grape juice, but not in white wine. Both red wine and grape juice are produced using whole grapes; white wine is produced without using the grape skins. It follows that the chemical that reduces blood cholesterol is present in the skins but not in the other parts of grapes.
zh:
①所有葡萄中都含有一种化学物质，有助于降低人体血液中的胆固醇。
②这种化学物质也存在于红葡萄酒和葡萄汁中，但不存在于白葡萄酒中。
③红葡萄酒和葡萄汁都是用完整的葡萄酿造的，而白葡萄酒是不用葡萄皮酿造的。
④由此推断，降低血液中胆固醇的化学物质存在于葡萄皮中，而不存在于葡萄的其他部分。

qs.stem: Which of the following is an assumption on which the argument depends?
qs.zh: 以下哪项是论证所依据的假设？

opts.t: Any product made from discarded grape skins would not contain the cholesterol-reducing chemical.
opts.cn: 用废弃的葡萄皮制成的任何产品都不会含有降低胆固醇的化学物质。

opts.t: The chemical that helps reduce blood cholesterol is the only chemical present in grape skins that is not also present in the other parts of grapes.
opts.cn: 有助于降低血液中胆固醇的化学物质是葡萄皮中唯一不存在于葡萄其他部分的化学物质。

opts.t: None of the chemicals that are present in grape skins are removed by any of the processing that is done during the production of red wine.
opts.cn: 在生产红葡萄酒的过程中，葡萄皮中的任何化学物质都不会被去除。

opts.t: The skins of grapes from which white wine is made are identical in chemical composition to the skins of either the grapes from which red wine is made or the grapes from which grape juice is made.
opts.h: The skins of grapes from which white wine is made are identical in chemical composition to the skins of either the grapes from which red wine is made or the grapes from which grape juice is made.
opts.cn: 酿造白葡萄酒的葡萄皮与酿造红葡萄酒的葡萄皮或酿造葡萄汁的葡萄皮的化学成分完全相同。

opts.t: There is nothing in the process used in making white wine that would destroy the cholesterol-reducing chemical.
opts.cn: 在酿造白葡萄酒的过程中，没有任何东西会破坏降低胆固醇的化学成分。

qs.label: E
qs.why:
背景：所有葡萄中都含有一种化学物质，有助于降低人体血液中的胆固醇。
证据：这种化学物质也存在于红葡萄酒和葡萄汁中，但不存在于白葡萄酒中。红葡萄酒和葡萄汁都是用完整的葡萄酿造的，而白葡萄酒是不用葡萄皮酿造的。
结论：降低血液中胆固醇的化学物质存在于葡萄皮中，而不存在于葡萄的其他部分。

论证的逻辑是，既然降低胆固醇的化学物质在红葡萄酒和葡萄汁中存在，但在白葡萄酒中不存在，而且红葡萄酒与葡萄汁使用的是整个葡萄（包括皮），白葡萄酒则不使用葡萄皮，因此可以推断这种化学物质存在于葡萄皮中。这个推断依赖于一个假设：在制作白葡萄酒的过程中没有任何步骤会破坏这种降低胆固醇的化学物质。如果在制作白葡萄酒的过程中存在某种可能会破坏这种化学物质的步骤，那么即使白葡萄酒不使用葡萄皮，也不能确定这种化学物质不在白葡萄酒中的原因就是因为不使用葡萄皮。选E选项。

其他选项：
Any product made from discarded grape skins would not contain the cholesterol-reducing chemical.
“用废弃皮做的产品是否含该物质”并不影响我们判断这种物质原本是否存在于皮中。

The chemical that helps reduce blood cholesterol is the only chemical present in grape skins that is not also present in the other parts of grapes.
我们只需要知道这种物质是否存在于皮中，不需要它是“唯一不在其他部位”的。

None of the chemicals that are present in grape skins are removed by any of the processing that is done during the production of red wine.
红酒中有这个物质就够了。即使红酒过程“去除”了皮中的其他物质，也不影响结论。

The skins of grapes from which white wine is made are identical in chemical composition to the skins of either the grapes from which red wine is made or the grapes from which grape juice is made.
即使不是“完全相同”，只要都有那种化学物质就可以支持结论。这不是必要的。
